name: z80-macroasm-vscode
modified: mdv lets the h-suffixed hexadecimal and the octal numbers start only at the beginning of a run of their digits, so a long run is not searched again from each of its digits.

name: AtariCode800
modified: mdv gives the semicolon comment rules the scope comment.line.semicolon.asm, lets operands end at a comment, rewrites the two macro-call patterns in unknown-fallback so they cannot backtrack exponentially, lets the label of the first one start only at the beginning of a word, and lets the binary, octal, decimal and h-suffixed hexadecimal numbers start only at the beginning of a run of their digits, so a long word is not searched again from each of its characters.
